2026-09-27用户裁定、实际回合生命周期修复和双方真实行动专项；不作为官方实时资料。
Official status guide, especially Faerie Fire, Reflect and Submerged; this source does not adjudicate Stealthy fixed-slot behavior.
Firsthand player observation of a Stealthy front slot hit by a first-two spell; community explanation is not an official developer ruling.

identity-cost-colors.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Stored English/native and live runtime match weapon ID, spell ID, Yellow mana, cost, both aliases and both team sides.

target-count-range.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Native FirstTwoEnemies means first two living front slots, each hit once; cases with 1-4 living targets, a dead front slot and first/second/all Stealthy. The Stealthy fixed-slot report is a firsthand player observation, not a developer ruling.

base-formula-rounding.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Each target receives one instance of normal spell damage Magic plus fixed base; tested Magic 0/1/11/20, armor 0/10, Web, Faerie Fire and spell resistance rounding.

boost-source-ratio-cap.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Official 9.4 removed Red gem removal and its boost. Native has one Damage step and no active counter or boost step; any legacy flag does not grant extra damage.

conditions-probabilities-branches.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Native has exactly one unconditional Damage step with no probability, conditional branch, extra hit or player-selected target.

status-duration-immunity.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): No status is applied. Real casts check Barrier, Submerged, Stealthy, Faerie Fire, Reflect, Spell Armor/Block, stun disabling Block, caster Silence/Web. Spell resistance is represented by Spell Armor/Block traits. Official status page supports Faerie Fire, Reflect and Submerged.

gems-types-selection-resolution.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Official 9.4 removed Red gem destruction; real cast with Red gems leaves board unchanged and generates no gem events.

summon-transform-pools.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Neither English text nor the sole native Damage step contains summon, transform or pool behavior.

order-death-retargeting.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Dead front slot is bypassed before selecting first two living targets; killing the first target does not add a third. Reflect resolves right after first hit, before second; Barrier blocks only the first hit.

mana-economy-extra-turn.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Successful cast pays listed mana and hands over turn from either side for both aliases. Insufficient mana, Silence or dead caster leaves resources/turn unchanged. No native extra-turn step.

display-description.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): Complete English clause, native Magic+base / FirstTwoEnemies, localized final text, both aliases and official 9.4 change agree; earlier Red-gem description is obsolete.

battle-pipeline.note: Icy Glaive (cost 8, base +3): TurnEngine.castSkill real battle entry for both sides/aliases, enemy counts, death, statuses, gem board, resources and turn; not just a compiler test.

clauseReviews.note: Complete English clause: Magic+3, two fixed front enemies, no gem removal, verified against official 9.4 and real-cast boundary/status tests.

nativeStepReviews.note: Single native Damage/FirstTwoEnemies step: Magic+3, two fixed front enemies, no gem removal, verified against official 9.4 and real-cast boundary/status tests. Legacy UseCounterForAmount has no current boost step and 9.4 removed the Red gem boost.

branchReviews.note: Single unconditional native main branch: Magic+3, two fixed front enemies, no gem removal, verified against official 9.4 and real-cast boundary/status tests.

pendingReasons: Submerged/Stealthy、法术抗性及状态交互独立依据未齐
